source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The newly added getMessageTest compares fetched bytes with messages[i].toMessageString() without a message argument. This one lexical assertion site runs in both EWS and Graph scenarios and needs a nonempty description of the expected content under the deliberate review requirement. The folder-count assertion already has such a message. This finding is separate from the should wording preference and does not claim a failing content comparison or test execution.
title: The raw-message comparison omits its expected-behavior assertion message
